patches_added.name: Auto check-in in the background
patches_added.description: Does the daily streak check-in without you opening ROX. Shortly after midnight (Pakistan time) an alarm that also fires while the phone sleeps wakes ROX; if today's check-in isn't done yet, ROX opens its own screen for a moment, presses Check-in and closes again. While the phone is in use that screen is see-through and lets your taps through, so you keep using what you had open. While the phone is locked it opens over the lock screen if full-screen notifications are allowed for ROX; otherwise the check-in waits and runs right after you next unlock the phone. If Android doesn't allow ROX to open itself, a notification on the next app open asks you to turn on "Appear on top" for ROX; until then it tries off-screen. It retries up to three times a day. A notification says when it worked, or asks you to tap it if it couldn't; the next time you open ROX a short message also says what the last background try did. You must be signed in, and ROX must have been opened once after installing. Force-stopping ROX stops it until the next time you open the app.

patches_added.name: Bypass Play Store check
patches_added.description: Stops ROX from sending a patched copy to the "Get this app from Play" screen and closing, so no separate installer-source patch is needed.

patches_added.name: Close when idle in background
patches_added.description: Closes ROX once it has been out of sight for three minutes and nothing is playing, so its timers, ad and analytics code stop using the battery. This also covers ROX being started in the background by a push message or a job. Notifications still arrive. Opening ROX after that is a fresh start.

patches_added.name: Skip forced update prompt
patches_added.description: Stops the "Update Available" screen that blocks ROX until you install a newer version, so this patched copy keeps working after ROX releases an update. ROX's own code is told the app is a newer version than it is; Android still sees the real version. Off by default: turn it on only if ROX shows that screen again before a new patched build is out.

patches_added.name: Stop background service
patches_added.description: Keeps ROX's background service from running. It can hold the phone awake, restarts itself when the system stops it and starts again after a reboot, which drains the battery. The check-in and the rest of the app don't need it.

ROX's own code is told the app is a newer version than it is; Android still sees the real version. Off by default: turn it on only if ROX shows that screen again before a new patched build is out.

patches_added.name: Stop background service
patches_added.description: Keeps ROX's background service from running. It can hold the phone awake, restarts itself when the system stops it and starts again after a reboot, which drains the battery. The check-in and the rest of the app don't need it.

patches_modified.name: Auto check-in daily streak
patches_modified.description: Presses the Daily Streak Check-in button for you when the app is open, once a day. It runs the app's own check-in, so it needs you to be signed in. Add "Auto check-in in the background" so you don't have to open the app each day.
patches_modified.previous_description: Presses the Daily Streak Check-in button for you when the app is open, once a day. It runs the app's own check-in, so it needs you to be signed in and to open the app each day.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Stops banner and full-screen ads from loading. Rewarded video ads are left alone, so the watch-an-ad-for-points option keeps working.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Removes inDrive's Google ads — the banner, the card shown during and after a ride, and the full-screen ones — by switching the app's own Google Ads enable flags off, so it never asks Google for an ad. Rides, chat, payments and inDrive's own promo codes keep working.

patches_modified.name: Account switcher private mode
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose whether the account switcher offers Anonymous Browsing or Incognito, even with one account. Choose in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches_modified.name: Content-type filter
patches_modified.description: Show only videos, images, text or link posts on Home and Popular.

patches_modified.name: Feed auto-scroll
patches_modified.description: Adds a play button to the navigation bar that slowly scrolls the feed on screen. Speed is set in bin0culars mods.

patches_modified.name: Post side panel
patches_modified.description: On tablets in landscape, opens posts in a panel on the right while the feed stays visible. Can be turned off in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches_modified.name: Same-subreddit full-screen media
patches_modified.description: Lets full-screen videos and images show only posts from the subreddit you opened. Turn it on in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches_modified.name: Share post content
patches_modified.description: App shortcuts and "Share via…" in the share sheet send the post's image, video or text instead of its link.

patches_modified.name: Tablet grid feed
patches_modified.description: Shows the feed as a grid with 2 or 3 columns on tablets and other wide screens. Phones are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Integrated Shizuku
patches_added.description: AARE starts its own Shizuku through wireless debugging, without the Shizuku app: pair once from Settings, and AARE starts it again by itself after a restart and when the car connects, on any Wi-Fi including the car's.
